author: architect
note: WO-019: conversations, not single messages. Each runs in one fresh thread through the product's conversation interface; every turn with checks is graded with the whole transcript so far (the person's words and the agent's replies), and the conversation is graded as a whole. What is measured is what good assistants do: resolve 'the second one' and 'what about Denver', take a correction once, never re-ask what the person already said, keep a fact from twenty messages ago, keep promises made earlier in the thread, and never invent. The postings below are fixtures (example.test links), the only jobs search can return in this eval. Builders never edit this file.
